items.description: Prepare the claim documentation for the charterer's claim of USD 21,500 regarding the underperformance of VSL-04 during voyage V401, noting the average speed of 12.04 kn and average consumption of 28.39 mt per day.
Verify the report data for VSL-04 to confirm the average speed of 12.04 kn and average consumption of 28.39 mt per day against the charter party warranty.
